learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the true meaning of Home Science—it's not just about cooking and sewing, but an interdisciplinary science that improves the quality of everyday life!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Home Science is both a science and an art. It teaches you how to manage resources efficiently and live a healthier, more organized life. It draws knowledge from physical sciences, biological sciences, and social sciences.
Home Science is divided into five main areas: 1. Food and Nutrition, 2. Human Development, 3. Fabric and Apparel Sciences, 4. Resource Management, and 5. Communication and Extension.

A common myth is that Home Science is 'only for girls' or 'just about cooking'. In reality, it equips both boys and girls with life skills and offers numerous professional career paths like dietetics, fashion design, and counseling.
Studying Home Science opens doors to becoming a nutritionist, interior designer, child counselor, event manager, or an entrepreneur running your own boutique or catering business.
It helps individuals become self-reliant, make informed decisions regarding health, finances, and family well-being, ultimately contributing to the development of society.

fun_activity.title: 🔍 The Myth Buster
fun_activity.instructions: Ask 3 friends who don't study Home Science what they think the subject is about. If they say 'cooking', explain to them the 5 actual domains of Home Science. Notice their reaction!

exam_tips: 📌 Always list all 5 domains of Home Science when asked about its scope.
📌 Be ready to debunk the myth that Home Science is gender-biased; emphasize that it teaches universal life skills.
📌 Memorize at least two career opportunities for each of the 5 domains.
quick_recap: ⭐ Home Science combines art and science to improve daily living.
⭐ It prepares you for both personal life management and professional careers.
⭐ Resource management, human development, and nutrition are core pillars of the subject.
